text:
maria: kicking off slow-roll to infer-v3.14 in eu-west — seed at 2% -> 10% over 30m. change window 13:30-14:00 UTC. will pin v3.13 if we see regressions.

deploybot: Deploy started: infer-service v3.14 -> eu-west (seed 2%)

alex: quick check — release notes uploaded? link: https://internal/release/notes/3.14

maria: yep, release notes + config diff at that link. main change: kv-cache tweak + batcher param bump.

sam: rollback criteria proposal:
- sustained 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m
- p50 latency increase > 40ms vs baseline for 10m
- embed quality drift alert on eval set
If any hit, call hold and pin.

jordan: noted. also watch prefix-cache OOM alarms (seen in canary earlier).

opsbot: telemetry: 5m rolling 5xx=0.07%, p50 +12ms (within noise)

maria: good. ops, live metrics please for the next 10m. I'll do quickvote at +10m.

deploybot: Traffic bumped to 5% at 14:00:00 UTC

opsbot: telemetry: 5xx=0.62% in eu-west (14:03), p50 +58ms

alex: hold — 5xx breached the threshold. recommend pin to v3.13 while we triage.

sam: agreed. immediate pin and rollback plan ready?

maria: executing pin now. deploybot, revert traffic routing to pinned v3.13.

deploybot: Routing change: pinned traffic -> v3.13 (effective 14:05:12 UTC). Revert initiated.

opsbot: post-pin telemetry: 5xx -> 0.09%, p50 back to +15ms

jordan: nice. can we capture heap profiles from the v3.14 pods for root cause?

maria: yes — Sam, can you grab profiles and post path?

sam: uploaded heap + trace at s3://infra-dumps/3.14/eu-west/14-05

maria: thanks. we'll schedule a follow-up postmortem if RCA points to runtime change. For now, resuming normal cadence.

alex: thumbs up. I'll update release notes with rollback entry.

maria: final: change window closed early at 14:08 UTC. Filing incident for RCA.

deploybot: Incident created: INC-2026-7142024000 — tag: canary-failure, owner: sam

maria: wrapping up — big thx for fast response :heart:
